sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times). Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor, rhythm varied (Alto); Answer in A minor (Soprano)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 35–37).
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bar 30) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: From A minor to F major

sections.label: Subject in F major (Soprano); Subject in G minor (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From G minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Subject in B♭ major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times). Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to D minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor
